evidence.text_en: D.S. al Coda is one of the devices used to return to an earlier point in the score and sing the same section again. Musical directions of this kind include repeat signs, Da Capo, Dal Segno, and Coda. D.S. is an abbreviation of Dal Segno and means to return to the Segno sign. al Coda means to move from the Coda sign to the next Coda sign.
